gaps: Land-rights contention is kept as institutional context, not attributed to climate. Crop-variety recovery is adaptive capacity, not a peace outcome.
NAP report publication precision corrected to April 2025; the cover does not support a specific first-of-month day. Physical/printed page conventions remain distinct.

executive_assessment.text: Brokopondo/Sipaliwini water systems and selected sites in Para/Marowijne add concrete adaptation detail, with institutional exclusion and monitoring gaps.
Historical interior flood/road impacts and differentiated preparedness sit alongside land-rights contention. IICA results are implementer reports, not causal effects or proven peace outcomes.
